prompt: According to the ACT, for 2023 identify of all the states to have an estimated at least 90% of their grads tested using the ACT, which of those states had a composite average score of at least 18.5, had at least 42% of test takers meet the English benchmark, had at least 19% meet the math benchmark, and at least 30% meet the reading benchmark.
instruction: According to the ACT, for 2023 identify of all the states to have an estimated at least 90% of their grads tested using the ACT, which of those states had a composite average score of at least 18.5, had at least 42% of test takers meet the English benchmark, had at least 19% meet the math benchmark, and at least 30% meet the reading benchmark.
answer:
Based on my research, I found the authoritative data for the ACT Class of 2023 from the Kentucky Department of Education, which published a table of the **8 states that test 100% of their graduates** — the only states meeting the ≥90% threshold.

Here are the 2023 results for those 8 states:

| State | Composite | % English (≥18) | % Math (≥22) | % Reading (≥22) | % Science (≥23) |
|-------|-----------|----------------|--------------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Wyoming | 19.0 | 48 | 37 | 25 | 27 |
| Kentucky | 18.7 | 49 | 36 | 23 | 24 |
| Tennessee | 18.4 | 47 | 33 | 23 | 23 |
| Louisiana | 18.2 | 47 | 32 | 19 | 22 |
| Alabama | 18.0 | 42 | 30 | 18 | 21 |
| Oklahoma | 17.8 | 42 | 30 | 16 | 19 |
| Mississippi | 17.6 | 41 | 26 | 16 | 16 |
| Nevada | 17.2 | 36 | 27 | 16 | 18 |

**Applying your criteria:**
1. **≥90% tested** → All 8 states qualify (100%)
2. **Composite ≥18.5** → Wyoming (19.0), Kentucky (18.7)
3. **English benchmark ≥42%** → Wyoming, Kentucky, Tennessee, Louisiana, Alabama, Oklahoma
4. **Math benchmark ≥19%** → All 8 states
5. **Reading benchmark ≥30%** → **None** — highest is Wyoming at 25%

**Answer: No states meet all five criteria.** The reading benchmark requirement (≥30%) eliminates every state — even the top performer (Wyoming) only had 25% of test-takers meet the reading benchmark.
